attributes.board_name: Tennessee Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored/approved by listed organizations (AAHA, AVMA specialty and practitioner associations …), accredited vet schools or AVMA-recognized specialty organizations, AAVSB RACE; other courses need Board approval
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt during the calendar year of graduation from an approved veterinary school.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; keep documentation 4 years after the calendar year of completion and produce it if the Board asks. Missed hours must be made up with a letter and certificates.

topics.who: Every two-year period: regulatory issues, controlled substances, or professional ethics

rules.notes: 20 h per calendar year, due Dec 31: at least 15 h medical/surgical, max 5 h other fields (practice management, regulatory programs); max 10 h multi-media (internet, webinars, teleconference). Licenses renew every 24 months.
